text: The sales forecast for Bread covers the period from August 16, 2017, to September 12, 2017, with a projected total of 47,785 units. This forecast uses a blend method, which averages the ETS and LightGBM forecasts, predicting an average of 1,707 units per day. This represents a 5.28 percent increase compared to the reference period average of 1,621 units per day. Sundays are projected to be the strongest sales days with an average of 2,381 units, while Thursdays are expected to be the weakest with 1,207 units.
